const CTX = CANVAS.getContext('2d', { alpha: false });
let W, H;
function resize(){
  const rect = CANVAS.getBoundingClientRect();
  W = CANVAS.width = rect.width;
  H = CANVAS.height = rect.height;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// pointer state
const pointer = { x: W/2, y: H/2, down: false, justDown: false };
CANVAS.addEventListener('pointermove', e=>{ const r=CANVAS.getBoundingClientRect(); pointer.x=e.clientX-r.left; pointer.y=e.clientY-r.top; });
CANVAS.addEventListener('pointerdown', e=>{ pointer.down=true; pointer.justDown=true; });
CANVAS.addEventListener('pointerup', ()=>{ pointer.down=false; });
// touch support
CANVAS.addEventListener('touchstart', e=>{ e.preventDefault(); const t=e.changedTouches[0]; const r=CANVAS.getBoundingClientRect(); pointer.x=t.clientX-r.left; pointer.y=t.clientY-r.top; pointer.down=true; pointer.justDown=true; }, {passive:false});
CANVAS.addEventListener('touchmove', e=>{ e.preventDefault(); const t=e.changedTouches[0]; const r=CANVAS.getBoundingClientRect(); pointer.x=t.clientX-r.left; pointer.y=t.clientY-r.top; }, {passive:false});
CANVAS.addEventListener('touchend', ()=>{ pointer.down=false; });

// ---------- AUDIO ----------
class Audio {
  constructor(){ this.ctx=null; this.ready=false; this.muted=false; this.ambientNode=null; }
  boot(){ if(!this.ctx){ this.ctx=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); } this.ready=true; }
  _start(){ if(this.ctx&&this.ctx.state==='suspended') this.ctx.resume(); }
  play(freq, dur=0.1, type='sine', vol=0.08, when=0){
    if(!this.ready||this.muted) return;
    this._start();
    const t=this.ctx.currentTime+when;
    const o=this.ctx.createOscillator();
    const g=this.ctx.createGain();
    o.type=type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t+dur);
    o.connect(g); g.connect(this.ctx.destination);
    o.start(t); o.stop(t+dur);
  }
  click(){ this.play(700,0.04,'square',0.04); }
  pick(){ this.play(1100,0.1,'sine',0.09); this.play(1600,0.08,'sine',0.07,0.06); }
  unlock(){ this.play(520,0.12,'sine',0.09); this.play(780,0.12,'sine',0.09,0.1); this.play(1040,0.2,'sine',0.08,0.2); }
  door(){ this._noise(0.35, 150, 400); }
  solve(){ const seq=[520,650,780,1040]; seq.forEach((f,i)=>this.play(f,0.14,'sine',0.08,i*0.09)); }
  error(){ this.play(120,0.3,'sawtooth',0.09); this.play(90,0.3,'sawtooth',0.07,0.15); }
  flicker(){ this.play(200,0.05,'sine',0.015); }
  _noise(dur, lo, hi){
    if(!this.ready||this.muted) return; this._start();
    const t=this.ctx.currentTime;
    const len=this.ctx.sampleRate*dur;
    const buf=this.ctx.createBuffer(1,len,this.ctx.sampleRate);
    const d=buf.getChannelData(0);
    for(let i=0;i<len;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1);
    const n=this.ctx.createBufferSource(); n.buffer=buf;
    const filt=this.ctx.createBiquadFilter(); filt.type='bandpass'; filt.frequency.value=(lo+hi)/2; filt.Q.value=2;
    const g=this.ctx.createGain(); g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15,t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,t+dur);
    n.connect(filt); filt.connect(g); g.connect(this.ctx.destination);
    n.start(t); n.stop(t+dur);
  }
  ambientLoop(){
    if(!this.ready||this.muted||this.ambientNode) return;
    this._start();
    const o=this.ctx.createOscillator(); o.type='sine'; o.frequency.value=70;
    const o2=this.ctx.createOscillator(); o2.type='sine'; o2.frequency.value=92;
    const g=this.ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value=0.03;
    const g2=this.ctx.createGain(); g2.gain.value=0.02;
    o.connect(g); o2.connect(g2); g.connect(this.ctx.destination); g2.connect(this.ctx.destination);
    o.start(); o2.start();
    this.ambientNode={o,o2,g,g2};
  }
  ambientStop(){ if(this.ambientNode){ this.ambientNode.o.stop(); this.ambientNode.o2.stop(); this.ambientNode=null; } }
}
const AUDIO = new Audio();
